title: Philip K. Dick's 1974 dream precognizing Close Encounters of the Third Kind
summary: Eric Wargo tells of Philip K. Dick's 1974 dream precognizing Close Encounters of the Third Kind, about 1974–1977 at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Eric Wargo, a researcher who writes about prophetic dreams, says the science fiction writer Philip K. Dick had a dream in 1974, described in his letters, where he was shown something like a brownie whose edges had been scored with a fork, and it was somehow a relief map. Wargo links this to Close Encounters of the Third Kind, a 1977 Steven Spielberg film about meeting aliens, and tells it as a case of a dream seeing the future.
